<thought>The previous search returned no templates when filtering by both broken functional groups. To locate the appropriate template, I will broaden the search criteria and only require that the forward reaction forms a C‑C double bond, which is characteristic of the Doebner modification. This should retrieve the relevant template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
